tools.name: bird_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (CRM records) in the workspace, newest first, as a cursor page. Bird API: GET /v1/contacts.

tools.name: bird_get_contact
tools.description: Fetch a single contact by id. Bird API: GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: bird_list_contact_properties
tools.description: List the custom contact-property definitions (schema) for the workspace. Bird API: GET /v1/contact-properties.

tools.name: bird_list_audiences
tools.description: List audiences (contact lists) in the workspace, newest first, as a cursor page. Bird API: GET /v1/audiences.

tools.name: bird_get_audience
tools.description: Fetch a single audience by id. Bird API: GET /v1/audiences/{audience_id}.

tools.name: bird_list_audience_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to a static audience, as a cursor page. Bird API: GET /v1/audiences/{audience_id}/contacts.

tools.name: bird_list_sms_messages
tools.description: List SMS messages (inbound + outbound) for the workspace, newest first, as a cursor page. Bird API: GET /v1/sms/messages.

tools.name: bird_get_sms_message
tools.description: Fetch a single SMS message by id. Bird API: GET /v1/sms/messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: bird_list_sms_templates
tools.description: List the SMS templates available to the workspace (Bird built-ins + your own). Bird API: GET /v1/sms/templates.

tools.name: bird_list_whatsapp_messages
tools.description: List WhatsApp messages (inbound + outbound) for the workspace, newest first, as a cursor page. Bird API: GET /v1/whatsapp/messages.

tools.name: bird_get_whatsapp_message
tools.description: Fetch a single WhatsApp message by id. Bird API: GET /v1/whatsapp/messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: bird_list_whatsapp_templates
tools.description: List the WhatsApp message templates available to the workspace. Bird API: GET /v1/whatsapp/templates.

tools.name: bird_list_email_messages
tools.description: List email messages sent from the workspace, newest first, as a cursor page. Bird API: GET /v1/email/messages.

tools.name: bird_get_email_message
tools.description: Fetch a single email message by id. Bird API: GET /v1/email/messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: bird_create_contact
tools.description: Creates a contact (CRM record) in Bird — additive, sends no message. Contacts are unique by email. Bird API: POST /v1/contacts.

tools.name: bird_create_audience
tools.description: Creates an audience (contact list) in Bird — additive, sends no message. Static audiences start empty. Bird API: POST /v1/audiences.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bird_list_sms_messages, bird_get_sms_message, bird_list_whatsapp_messages, bird_get_whatsapp_message, bird_list_whatsapp_templates, bird_list_email_messages, bird_get_email_message, bird_create_audience · Private data: bird_list_contacts, bird_get_contact, bird_list_contact_properties, bird_list_audiences, bird_list_audience_contacts, bird_create_contact, bird_create_audience · Public sink: bird_list_sms_messages, bird_get_sms_message, bird_list_sms_templates, bird_list_email_messages, bird_get_email_message, bird_create_contact, bird_create_audience.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bird_list_sms_messages, bird_get_sms_message, bird_list_whatsapp_messages, bird_get_whatsapp_message, bird_list_whatsapp_templates, bird_list_email_messages, bird_get_email_message, bird_create_audience · Private data: bird_list_contacts, bird_get_contact, bird_list_contact_properties, bird_list_audiences, bird_list_audience_contacts, bird_create_contact, bird_create_audience · Public sink: bird_list_sms_messages, bird_get_sms_message, bird_list_sms_templates, bird_list_email_messages, bird_get_email_message, bird_create_contact, bird_create_audience

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
